reason: Req 1/2 are not correctly implemented: sign_path_token uses hashlib.sha256(path:expires_at) and ignores the secret; verify_path_token only compare_digest(expected, token) and does not enforce now <= expires_at. This violates the ticket requirements for HMAC-SHA256 with secret and time-bounded verification, risking security regression despite passing current tests.
target_issue: Missing requirement enforcement: verify_path_token must return False when now > expires_at and must compute HMAC-SHA256(secret, f'{path}:{int(expires_at)}') with constant-time compare_digest.
thoughts: Need to inspect repo changes and run tests to ensure requirements met and no regressions.
